items.subject: School fireworks evening
items.new_text: The school fireworks event was scheduled for 5 November. The final notice confirmed tickets had sold out and entry was for ticket holders only.
items.excerpt: The school fireworks event was scheduled for 5 November. The final notice confirmed tickets had sold out and entry was for ticket holders only.
points: Children were to be collected as normal; clubs were running, but pupils could not stay on site between the school day and the event.
Entry was exclusively through The Paddock gate on The Vines, with tickets exchanged for wristbands. Lockington Grove and King Edward Road gates were not event entrances.

items.subject: Junior Music Showcase · Years 1–3
items.new_text: Scheduled for Monday 16 November at 4pm in Chadlington Hall, with an expected finish around 4:30pm. Blake was invited to play violin.
items.excerpt: Scheduled for Monday 16 November at 4pm in Chadlington Hall, with an expected finish around 4:30pm. Blake was invited to play violin.
points: Mrs Walland and Blake had chosen Frere Jacques.
The reminder asked pupils to bring their instrument and music. Staff would escort them to the hall after school for a snack, drink and run-through.
Audience arrival was from 3:45pm through the brown arched gate off Lockington Grove; family and friends were welcome.
The invitation requested an attendance and collection response by Wednesday 11 November.
This records the school’s arrangements, not confirmation of attendance or performance.
items.teacher_comment: Mrs Walland and Blake have identified 'Frere Jacques' as the piece he will play..

reasons.text: Mentions Blake by name in the message itself.

items.subject: Harvest Festival · Year 3 · Friday 16 October
items.new_text: 9am in Chadlington Hall. Parents are invited to the Pre-Preparatory Harvest Festival, which includes Year 3.
items.excerpt: 9am in Chadlington Hall. Parents are invited to the Pre-Preparatory Harvest Festival, which includes Year 3.
points: Donations support Caring Hands in Chatham: tinned soup, beans, tomatoes, vegetables, tuna or meat; rice, pasta, lentils, cereal or porridge oats; tea, coffee, biscuits or sugar.
Also in the newsletter: Firework Night is Thursday 5 November on the Paddock. The school event page lists 6.30pm; ticket details are still to follow.
The advertised orchestra is for Years 8–13, not Year 3. The older pupils’ Harvest services on 12 and 13 October are not Year 3’s service.

items.subject: Year 3 Demelza Carolathon
items.new_text: Friday 27 November at Fremlin Walk, Maidstone. The performance starts at 11am.
items.excerpt: Friday 27 November at Fremlin Walk, Maidstone. The performance starts at 11am.
points: Give trip consent using the link in the school’s original letter. No consent deadline is stated.
School minibuses leave at 10am and return at approximately noon. Wear full school uniform; there is no cost to parents.
Parents are invited to watch. School staff remain responsible for supervising the children throughout.
items.teacher_comment: If you haven't already, please sign the consent form for your child to be able to take part in the Demelza Carolathon on Friday 27th November.

items.subject: Murder Mystery Night
items.new_text: Saturday 28 November, School Hall. Adults only: parents, guardians and staff; no pupils or children. Doors open at 7pm; the show starts at 7:30pm.
items.excerpt: Saturday 28 November, School Hall. Adults only: parents, guardians and staff; no pupils or children. Doors open at 7pm; the show starts at 7:30pm.
points: The advertised £25 ticket includes the show, welcome drink, three-course meal and coffee.
The school letter set a booking deadline of noon on Monday 16 November, which has passed. Current availability is not confirmed.
If attending, arrange childcare and bring cash for entry plus £1 coins for games. Drinks are available to buy; own drinks are not permitted.
The raffle welcomes donated prizes, vouchers, experiences or gifts through the school charities contact. No donation deadline is stated.

items.subject: Children’s hospital toy collection
items.new_text: Optional Christmas toy donations can be left at St Nicholas Office by Wednesday 9 December.
items.excerpt: Optional Christmas toy donations can be left at St Nicholas Office by Wednesday 9 December.
points: Bring brand-new, unwrapped, wipe-clean toys in secure packaging, such as playsets, board games or craft kits.
No soft toys, teddy bears, used items or wrapped gifts.
Salvation Army donations go to Chadlington Office instead.

items.subject: Salvation Army toy appeal
items.new_text: Optional donations of new, unwrapped toys or gifts. For Little Kings–Year 3, take donations to Chadlington Office; no school-office cutoff is stated.
items.excerpt: Optional donations of new, unwrapped toys or gifts. For Little Kings–Year 3, take donations to Chadlington Office; no school-office cutoff is stated.
points: For Year 3’s suggested age band (5–9), the school suggests educational games and toys, stationery, books, puzzles, wordsearches and crosswords.
Small chocolate selection boxes are also welcome: they must be nut-free, with any potential allergens clearly identified.

The public collection deadline is Sunday 6 December at Chatham Salvation Army (4 Church Street), Gillingham Salvation Army (50 Green Street) and Strood Salvation Army (Gun Lane). This is not a confirmed Chadlington Office deadline.
The school’s 7 and 8 December Toy Services are for older pupils; Little Kings–Year 3 use the office drop-off instead.
